memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Dyslipidaemia
  - Status: LDL 118 mg/dL, HDL 42 mg/dL, TG 190 mg/dL; on atorvastatin 10 mg HS.
  - Plan: Continue atorvastatin, repeat lipid profile in 3 months, consider adding fenofibrate if TG remains >150.
- Gastro-oesophageal reflux
  - Symptoms: mild heartburn after meals, relieved by antacid gel.
  - Status: Currently on pantoprazole 40 mg OD before breakfast, domperidone 10 mg BD before meals, antacid gel SOS.
  - Plan: Continue PPI, review need for long-term therapy, consider H. pylori stool antigen if symptoms persist.
- Weight 62 kg, waist 84 cm (female cut‑off 80 cm – above target).
  - Advice: Breakfast – high‑fibre cereal with skim milk; Lunch – mixed vegetable salad with lean protein; Dinner – grilled fish, steamed veggies, small portion rice.
Due: HbA1c not applicable.

memories.author: D04
memories.text: Upper GI endoscopy performed due to persistent mild dyspepsia. Findings: Grade A reflux esophagitis, no Barrett’s epithelium, H. pylori negative on biopsy. No ulcers or masses.

memories.author: patient
memories.text: "Since the endoscopy I feel better; heartburn now only after large meals and improves with antacid."
